name: Cesu
short_description: Espace personnel du Chèque Emploi Service Universel
description: Se connecte à l'espace particulier employeur sur www.cesu.urssaf.fr, le service de l'Urssaf pour déclarer et payer un salarié à domicile, pour en récupérer les déclarations et documents.

status.notes: Fixed a false `ALREADY_LOGGED_IN`: `#deconnexion_link` is in the static header of every cesu.urssaf.fr page, logged out included, so a stale session skipped the login and then found no "Mes déclarations" / "Mon avantage fiscal" links on what was really the login form; the logged-in marker is now the "Mes déclarations" menu link. Credentials are accepted, but the remembered device has lapsed and login now asks for the emailed one-time code again, so the document download (12 bulletins de salaire + 1 attestation fiscale, real PDFs, on 2026-10-09) is not re-confirmed since the fix; whether the session survives across runs is not re-confirmed either
